column1: # Reviewed ForeverDB.net observations accepted into the LootJinx catalog.
# Check the item page for a direct NPC source before using dungeon-page
# observations. Fight-level observations can include drops from nearby trash.
# Exclude world drops without a direct dungeon source, quest items, trade goods,
# keys, lockboxes and gear with ambiguous sources.
# Existing ForeverDungeonJournal sources always win: a row that contradicts them
# is reported as a conflict and never overwrites the catalog.
# Format: dungeon<TAB>source group<TAB>itemID<TAB>item name<TAB>observed drops<TAB>observed kills<TAB>source URL
